visualCharacteristics: About band: 28/36 px ink section title over two rich-text columns on the 4/8/12-column grid (stacked on mobile, side by side from 768).
contentPattern: One cell per row: a heading-only row is the title; the first text row fills column 1, all later text rows fill column 2.
usage: Use for an "About" section with a title and two columns of descriptive body text.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any title-plus-two-text-columns introduction; author the heading first, then one row per column.
